# Game Idea: Asteroid Dodge

- Player controls a ship at the bottom of the HTML canvas.
- Asteroids spawn at the top and fall downward, accelerating over time.
- Move left/right with arrow keys to dodge.
- **Lose condition:** an asteroid collides with the ship.
- Score is time survived or number of asteroids avoided.

<content>
1: // game.js – simple asteroid‑dodge game
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   // Audio setup
7:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
8:   function playTone(freq, dur) {
9:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
10:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
11:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
12:     osc.type = 'sine';
13:     osc.connect(gain);
14:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
15:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
16:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
17:     osc.start();
18:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
19:   }
20: 
21:   // Canvas size (fallback if not set in HTML/CSS)
22:   canvas.width = canvas.width || 800;
23:   canvas.height = canvas.height || 600;
24: 
25:   // Ship configuration
26:   const ship = {
27:     w: 40,
28:     h: 20,
29:     x: canvas.width / 2 - 20,
30:     y: canvas.height - 30,
31:     speed: 5,
32:   };
33: 
34:   // Asteroid data
35:   const stars = [];
36:   const starCount = 100;
37:   // Initialize stars
38:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
39:     stars.push({
40:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
41:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
42:       r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
43:     });
44:   }
45:   const asteroids = [];
46:   const asteroidSize = 30;
47:   let asteroidTimer = 0;
48:   const asteroidInterval = 90; // frames between spawns
49:   let speedIncrease = 0.001; // acceleration per frame
50: 
51:   // Score and state
52:   let score = 0;
53:   let gameOver = false;
54: 
55:   // Input handling
56:   const keys = { ArrowLeft: false, ArrowRight: false };
57:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
58:     // Ensure audio context is running after user interaction
59:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
60:     if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = true;
61:   });
62:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
63:     if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = false;
64:   });
65: 
66:   function spawnAsteroid() {
67:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - asteroidSize);
68:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -asteroidSize, w: asteroidSize, h: asteroidSize, v: 2 });
69:     // Sound for asteroid spawn
70:     playTone(200, 0.05);
71:   }
72: 
73:   function update() {
74:     // Move ship
75:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x = Math.max(0, ship.x - ship.speed);
76:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x = Math.min(canvas.width - ship.w, ship.x + ship.speed);
77: 
78:     // Spawn asteroids periodically
79:     if (asteroidTimer++ >= asteroidInterval) {
80:       spawnAsteroid();
81:       asteroidTimer = 0;
82:     }
83: 
84:     // Update asteroid positions
85:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
86:       a.v += speedIncrease;
87:       a.y += a.v;
88:     });
89: 
90:     // Remove passed asteroids, update score, check collisions
91:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
92:       const a = asteroids[i];
93: if (a.y > canvas.height) {
94:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
95:           score++;
96:           // Sound for successful dodge / score increment
97:           playTone(600, 0.05);
98:         } else if (rectsCollide(a, ship)) {
99:           // Sound for collision / game over
100:           playTone(400, 0.2);
101:           gameOver = true;
102:         }
103:     }
104:   }
105: 
106:   function rectsCollide(r1, r2) {
107:     return (
108:       r1.x < r2.x + r2.w &&
109:       r1.x + r1.w > r2.x &&
110:       r1.y < r2.y + r2.h &&
111:       r1.y + r1.h > r2.y
112:     );
113:   }
114: 
115:   function draw() {
116:     // Background (starfield)
117:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
118:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
119:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
120:     stars.forEach(s => {
121:       ctx.beginPath();
122:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
123:       ctx.fill();
124:     });
125: 
126:     // Ship (triangle)
127:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0af';
128:     ctx.beginPath();
129:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
130:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
131:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
132:     ctx.closePath();
133:     ctx.fill();
134: 
135:     // Asteroids (circles)
136:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
137:       ctx.fillStyle = '#a33';
138:       ctx.beginPath();
139:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.w / 2, a.y + a.h / 2, a.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
140:       ctx.fill();
141:     });
142: 
143:     // Score display
144:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
145:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
146:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
147: 
148:     if (gameOver) {
149:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
150:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
151:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
152:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
153:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
154:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
155:       ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score}`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 30);
156:     }
157:   }
158: 
159:   function loop() {
160:     if (!gameOver) {
161:       update();
162:       draw();
163:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
164:     } else {
165:       draw(); // final frame with overlay
166:     }
167:   }
168: 
169:   // Kick‑off the game loop
170:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
171: })();

(End of file - total 171 lines)
</content>
